text.tspan: Land animals slaughtered if all countries produced meat like..1961 to 2024
Hypothetical number of land animals that would be slaughtered globally if all countries had the same per-capita
number of slaughtered animals as a given country. The curve for "World" gives the actual global number of land
Data source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
